entry.name: Blaziken-S3
entry.flavor: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
entry.flavorEs: Blaziken tiene unas piernas tan fuertes que puede saltar por encima de un edificio de 30 pisos con facilidad. Además, da unos puñetazos fulminantes que dejan al oponente chamuscado y lleno de tizne.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Fire attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Fuego infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其火属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Fogo infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.
abilities.textEs: Aumenta su Velocidad en cada turno.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.
abilities.detailEs: La Velocidad de este Pokémon sube un nivel después de cada turno.
abilities.detailZh: 每回合结束后，该宝可梦的速度提高1级。
abilities.detailPt: A Velocidade deste Pokémon sobe um estágio após cada turno.
